articles.title: The Sun Is About to Disappear Over Europe—Here's How to Watch!
articles.summary: On August 12, the Moon will completely cover the Sun over parts of Europe. ESA will broadcast it live from Spain, where the sky will go dark for over a minute. You can watch telescopes and drones capture the moment online.

articles.title: Did Eating Potatoes Give Some People a Superpower?
articles.summary: Scientists found that Indigenous people in Peru have extra copies of a gene that helps digest starch. This likely happened because their ancestors ate lots of potatoes for thousands of years. They have more copies than anyone else studied.

articles.title: SpaceX Just Launched 29 Satellites—and the Booster Has Flown 18 Times!
articles.summary: SpaceX sent 29 more Starlink satellites to space on August 11. The rocket's first stage landed on a drone ship for the 18th time. This booster has also carried astronauts, and Starlink now has over 10,900 satellites in orbit.
